title: PromotionMarketSegment - Data API
description: Represents a market segment within B2B Commerce that promotions can be assigned to. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only for orgs with the multicurrency feature enabled. Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the organization.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the promotion segment.

PromotionId.description: The ID of the promotion that you want to associate with your promotion segment. This is a relationship field.

PromotionSegmentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PromotionSegmentId.description: The ID of the promotion segment that you want to associate with. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: The PromotionMarketSegment object is available only if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.
